model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each of seven evaluation criteria when assessing a system or interface, with the criteria listed along the vertical axis and the participant count shown on the horizontal axis ranging from 0 to 6. The tallest bar corresponds to “Relevant FCs” with 6 participants, followed by “FC Summary” with 5 participants. “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” are tied at 3 participants each, while “Overall Summary” received 2 selections. The least selected criteria are “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation,” each chosen by only 1 participant. The bars are color-coded in shades of purple, blue, green, and yellow, and are arranged in descending order of participant count from top to bottom, visually emphasizing the most frequently selected criteria.
